state_meaning: AI-drafted candidate; no person has reviewed it.
text: The authors require a debate protocol to specify honest-prover behaviour for both x in L and x not in L, with the honest prover winning with higher probability while running in time Ptime against any computationally unbounded dishonest strategy, which they present as formalising that debates should make telling the truth easier than lying. Doubly-efficient debate is the setting where Ptime is polynomial in n, verifier time is linear in the query length l and linear (ideally sub-linear) in n, and the verifier makes a sub-linear (ideally constant) number of oracle queries.
title: Doubly-efficient debate definition: efficient honest prover vs unbounded dishonest prover
